_what_this_is: A stand-in for GET /earth, /trust and /forecast, written by hand for tests/visual/gate.sh. It is NOT a capture from any node — no node has ever had all three populated at once for a script to capture. It exists only so measure.mjs has something plausible to serve when PAI_RICH=1, so the satellite strip, the AlphaEarth record, the trust card and the forecast card can be looked at populated at least once. Keep it small: this is a fixture for a rendering test, not sample data.

credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, processed by Google Earth Engine.
Landsat courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.

forecast._comment_hours: hour_offsets are hours from render time, not absolute timestamps — a fixture with a baked-in past date would render as an all-past forecast the moment the file got old. measure.mjs turns each offset into Date.now() + offset*3600000 when PAI_RICH is set.
